title: Tag releases and write the changelog with Semantic Release
description: `release.config.cjs` on `main`: version tag, GitHub release and changelog from `feat:` and `fix:` titles. Nothing is published to a package registry.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in PR #1. release.yml on push to main (paths-ignore project/**), release.config.cjs (conventionalcommits preset, GitHub release; GITHUB_TOKEN only; no registry). Dry run against the repo analysed 15 commits: no release (no feat/fix yet). The changelog is the GitHub release notes; a committed CHANGELOG.md would need a bot push to protected main, which needs a decision from Ryan.
